title: Serves its purpose but flimsy
text: Serves its purpose but flimsy. The pans are a lot smaller than anticipated. I was expecting these aluminum foil pans to more sturdy material wise, but it's actually pretty thin/flimsy and definitely a disposable product. It does serve its purpose for immediate use or meal planning/storage but after baking and taking it out.. be careful holding because it bends easily. I would not repurchase these pans again though.
